install_method: Private venv,baseCondaunchanged,no wheel cache;pipreports and fullfreeze before tiny smoke.
storage_scope: Private persistent mount;reported filesystem capacity is shared/global,not an attested per-user storage quota.
credentials: SSH authentication and exact host identity kept outside repository;known-hosts first-use pinned,strict verification for subsequent connections.
failure_rule: One install/preparation invocation in unique root;retain failures/partialenv,do not retry or alter baseenv/localcomputer. A correction needs a new explicit plan/root.
